# The engine's `document-drafts-attach-v1` route set (U-95, engine PR #180):
# the document draft attach, `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json,
# keyed with idempotency-docs-v1's contract under its own capability name.
# Append-only for this capability name. A04 covers it: `keyable-docs-attach`
# in operations.txt (`KeySet::DocsAttachV1`), keyed only while the engine
# advertises `document-drafts-attach-v1`.
